To talk to someone with Live Translate mode:
Say “Hey Google” to activate your voice assistant. Then say “Open the translate app.”
This launches Google Translate in Live Translate mode in the languages that you select. The app listens for both languages and displays the translations on your phone.
To have a specific message read back to you, tap the speaker icon in the top right corner of the translated message.
